_doc: R33-5 (task #510) -- paired A/B config for the R32-10 OWN_CACHE_SIZE latency-null verification. Re-runs the SAME harness (examples/r32_10_own_cache_tier1_thrash_gate.rs) in child mode (R32_10_CHILD_K=<k> env var) through paired-ab-runner.mjs's A/B/B/A protocol, 20 pairs. 'before' = OWN_CACHE_SIZE=4 (patch 9da1a54e83cec28adae585eeb1d2e55a93f44581f9471f13b268ff9fe85892ae over HEAD 7d55209de6159bd42397fc28a746715c97fc91a5). 'after' = OWN_CACHE_SIZE=16 (HEAD 7d55209...). Metric is churn_elapsed_ns (integer ns, parsed correctly by the runner); ns_per_op = churn_elapsed_ns / (ROTATING_ROUNDS * K) is derived in the report. The env var R32_10_CHILD_K is set by the caller before invoking the runner.

sanity._doc_sanity: Every arm's path-activation oracle #2 (tier1_total == expected_total) must report PASS (1) -- a FAIL means the arm did not exercise its intended mechanism and its churn_elapsed_ns is not trustworthy evidence.
